report.notes: Added _RUN_TOGETHER (redact.py) and an identical RUN_TOGETHER (snapshot.js), applied next to _SENSITIVE_WORDS. Long stems (password|passwd|passcode|passphrase|pwd|cvv|cvc|ccv) match anywhere in a word; mpin/tpin and otp only at the start or end of a word or before a known ending; pin/pass/code only after a known prefix. tricky_fields.html gains 20 sensitive inputs (r1-r20) and 10 ordinary ones (q1-q10). New tests: Python sensitivity for all 20 reviewer names, 15 ordinary names stay readable, values absent from the data passed on for the Brain request (checked through PE.normalise, not the full assist_ask path the reviewer probed), JS pattern identical to the Python one, and a real-Chromium check that the values are removed in the page and JS and Python agree. With the fix: tests/assist + tests/web give 301 passed, 0 skipped. Base check: checking out the base files was denied, so uri_assist and tests/assist were extracted from 16f75d8 into a scratch copy with the new tests and fixture; all new must-fail tests fail there and the readable-name tests pass. 8 other tests failed in that copy only because uri_web and uri_operational_intelligence were not copied (ModuleNotFoundError). Limits: the name lists are a deny-list, so a run-together name with an unlisted prefix (e.g. foopin) is not caught, and userpincode is deliberately left readable as a postal PIN code. graphify update was not run (graphify not installed, exit 127).
